text_block_list.text:
Having caught wind of a race Jungle Pocket 
was entering, I came to watch—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san! You came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course. It's your big stage, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be supporting you, so give it 
everything you've got. Oh, mind if I cheer 
you on in the underground tunnel too?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha, thanks! But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Stay in the stands, please. Today, I want 
you strictly as a spectator.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blow your mind, Fuji-san. Just 
like a real "miracle"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Is that Jungle Pocket? She's surprisingly 
attached to Fuji Kiseki, how cute!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I heard she used to be much scarier and 
rough around the edges... Well, rumors are 
just rumors, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look at 'em all lined up, acting tough. 
But let me tell ya—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
..."The strongest" is me. Brace yourselves 
for the storm!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now, rounding the fourth corner and 
heading into the home stretch! The race 
shifts in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her surge forward! What 
insane drive...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! Someone else is catching up! Are 
they going to run neck-and-neck?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Tch!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Don't you dare falter now... Show 'em! 
Hit 'em hard with that "thrill" from back 
then!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ghh, AAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket pulls away once more! The 
leader is Jungle Pocket, crossing the 
finish line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOORRAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
T-This is Jungle Pocket...?! S-So 
terrifyingly fierce...!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san... incredible. Pokke-san really 
is the "strongest"...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Pokke! That was a truly 
spectacular run!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks a ton! I've watched your 
races so many times, after all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep charging full speed ahead 
and become the "strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Strong enough that I'll fulfill your dream 
of 'showing everyone a miracle' right 
alongside it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ahaha! That's quite the ambition!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't entrust that dream to you just 
yet... but indeed. Pokke, I have high 
hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Hope away! And... someday, let's 
clash for the very top!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I look forward to that day!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we have a party? To 
celebrate the victory of my comrade and 
rival!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sweet, thanks Fuji-san! Is there anything 
I can do to help?

Fuji Kiseki and Jungle Pocket—witnessing 
the bond between the two of them filled me 
with warmth.
(Grooooowl...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, should we fill our bellies first?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Ah man, haha. That totally ruined 
the cool moment.

A caring senior and an innocent junior. 
While they seemed that way now, I looked 
forward to seeing how they would continue 
to grow.
